adjudication.rationale: The migration backfills `embeddable_hosts.category_id` by joining `site_settings.value` to `categories.name` (`WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'` and `s.value = c.name`), then taking the first row (`[0]['id']`). From the diff, `TopicEmbed` previously passed `category: SiteSetting.embed_category`, which could plausibly have been an id-like string (since the setting had no declared type) or any non-name identifier; in those cases the join would not match and the migration would fall back to uncategorized (or even raise if the result set is empty due to `[0]` on an empty result). If multiple categories could share a name, `[0]` would pick an arbitrary match. This is a correctness/data-migration issue introduced by the diff.
